_note: Generic, key-independent section templates. A section's chords come from the song's harmonic plan (data/section-harmony.json: a rule per section over the chosen progression), resolved in the selected key; how it's played comes from data/section-recipes.json. The order here is the order the Generator's cards appear in (the order each part first plays in the Standard form); the running order itself is in data/song-forms.json.

sections.label: Intro
sections.strumFeel: power chords per data/section-recipes.json; the Chords page can replace it with an intro melody (lib/melody.ts)
sections.caption: 4 bars · the chorus's first two chords

sections.label: Verse
sections.strumFeel: the progression's own chords, palm-muted and sparser than the Chorus (data/section-recipes.json); shown once, played twice
sections.caption: 8 bars

sections.label: Pre-chorus
sections.strumFeel: a climb that builds from palm-muted to ringing and sets up the Chorus's first chord
sections.caption: 4 bars · build

sections.label: Chorus
sections.strumFeel: open, ringing full chord hits (not palm-muted) — the section that showcases the selected progression from progressions.json
sections.caption: Open, ringing

sections.label: Solo
sections.caption: Lead solo
sections.note: Written by the lead engine (lib/melody.ts, data/lead-rules.json): 8 bars, Classic by default; the Chords page can send a different solo (style, length, take).

sections.label: Breakdown
sections.strumFeel: half-time, heavy hits on the progression's darkest two chords (data/section-harmony.json)
sections.caption: Half-time, heavy
sections.note: Breakdown always renders in the Half-Time drum feel regardless of the page's selected Feel, per genre convention.

sections.label: Ending
sections.strumFeel: one final hit on the tonic, let ring or stopped
sections.caption: 1 bar · final hit
